name: Written Prophecy
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. One finished, original full-bleed card illustration for the fantasy deckbuilding game Panlibrarium. Painterly dark fantasy book illustration, rich oil and gouache brushwork, tangible aged brass, bone parchment and deep ink, sophisticated dramatic chiaroscuro, restrained luminous magic, atmospheric depth. A compelling concrete scene with a single strong focal silhouette, immediately readable when small, not a diagram or icon. Landscape 3:2. Keep key subject in central 70%, no important details near edges. No card frame, no text or lettering or readable writing, no numbers, no UI, no logo, no watermark. No flat vector art, no modern objects, no gore. New standalone artwork.
Card identity: Written Prophecy (written_prophecy). Paint a distinctive concrete interpretation of this title and power, with varied composition and a strong central silhouette.
Gameplay inspiration: Draw 2 cards. Deal 2 damage. Deal 2 damage per card drawn this turn. Your next draw goes to discard this turn. Exhaust. Signature: COPY_LAST_CARD_TO_HAND.
World: Mythic ancient Greek world, marble, bronze, laurel, Mediterranean azure and warm white stone; epic classical atmosphere.
Avoid repeating a generic figure with a book: focus on the actual named subject or magic in action. Spells must be luminous filaments or material magic, no floating letters or words.
